title: Optimizing Subspace Expansion in Quantum Chemistry through Operator Selection and Reference State Choice
summary: The Virtual Quantum Subspace Expansion (VQSE) extends the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) by leveraging additional measurements on the reference state to capture the influence of excluded virtual orbitals. This makes VQSE attractive for chemical applications where accurate energy differences along potential energy surfaces are crucial for modeling reaction rates and kinetics. In this work, we analyze VQSE performance on H$_2$ dissociation including references that use Hartree--Fock molecular orbitals with broken spin symmetry.
